translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: NaIpru gail
book.title: NaIpru gail Nalob̃ulat napisulan van hǝn naIpru gail

content: Sutuai tia len ahai kelkel ur gail, aGot isor vǝha-sob̃sob̃ur mai atǝmadat gail ta sutuai len naṽide tiltile gail.

Len nǝboŋ galegai hǝn nanoŋan hǝn navile a pan, aGot isor. Len aNatun isor mai gidato. Itabtabuh len aNatun hǝn natit p̃isi lǝb̃evi esan sǝb̃on. Len aNatun, aGot igol nǝmav mai navile a pan mai natit p̃isi lan.

ANatun evi nam̃ialan hǝn namǝnas hǝn nǝyalyalan siGot. Ilav kot aGot, ep̃itoṽ hǝn nab̃oruan siGot. Len nasoruan hǝn nǝdaŋan san etǝgau gat natit p̃isi hum lotomaienan. Nǝboŋ togol naveveuan dan nǝsaan, ebǝtah len navǝlan nǝmatu seKiŋ len nǝmav a mǝhat.
ANatun aGot iyalyal sǝhor aŋel gail
Imaienan aGot igol aNatun iyalyal sǝhor aŋel gail, hum nǝhes aGot tolav maii toyalyal sǝhor nahǝsalit gail.
Husur aGot sakel mai aŋel ideh ke,
Ale aGot sakel mai aŋel ideh ke,
Ale tǝtas am, nǝboŋ aGot togol ahai a m̃o san b̃egǝm vi lan navile a pan, ike,
Nǝboŋ tosor husur aŋel gail, aGot ike,
Be nǝboŋ tosor mai aNatun ike,

content.text: “O Got, nab̃iltihai bǝtbǝtah sam̃ hum sekiŋ
Imaienan, aGot tovi aGot sam̃ evǝhas gaiug,
eb̃ir naoil hǝn nahǝhaṽuran len gaiug
“Nasub̃, len natub̃atan goriŋ nǝpaudesen hǝn navile a pan,
ale nǝmav, gotoum hǝni hǝn navǝlam̃ gǝlaru.
Be gaiug dereh gitoh vi sutuai.
Dereh gebul gat nǝmav mai navile a pan
ale gel gǝlaru hum nahurabat artomatu.
ale nǝmauran sam̃ asike inoŋ vi sutuai.”

content: Ale aGot sakel mai aŋel ideh ke,

content.text: vir nǝb̃eriŋ naenemi sam̃ gail pipit nariem̃ gǝlaru

content: Be aŋel gail lumabe? Lovi nanunun hǝn nauman siGot ŋai. Esǝvat galit hǝn lǝb̃evi tarhǝt silat, gai tolav kuv galit dan nǝsaan hǝn lǝb̃ikad nǝmauran vi sutuai.

footnotes.text: 1.10 Len naut egai nǝvanuan totos nǝb̃e enan isor husur aGot hum tovi vanuan tokad navǝlan gǝlaru.
